summary: {person} brings the proposal residents chose to a hearing on what the department will actually receive.
realLife: Seattle’s ordinance records a winning restroom proposal costed at $7.2 million and appropriates $2.2 million to the parks department’s capital program.
gates: A winning public proposal and an enacted allocation for its project.
weights: A large difference between those amounts gives the sponsor a reason to ask what can open.
inGame: needs: ballot proposal amount, receiving appropriation and funded scope.

turns.what: The department submits a narrower site list.
turns.pulledBy: The sponsor asks which sites the smaller amount can serve.
turns.writesBack: Attach it to the funding decision.

turns.what: The sponsor asks for a costed expansion.
